description: Read the comments people left on a page: { page_id, url, commentsEnabled, threads: [{ id, resolved, on, comments: [{ id, author, body, createdAt }] }] }. Each thread is a pin someone dropped on the page; `on` is the text of the element they clicked, so you can tell what the comment is about without seeing the page. author is the commenter's full email. Read-only. Typical loop: list_comments → update_page with the fixes → resolve_comment on each thread you addressed. Open threads only unless include_resolved is true. Fails with page_not_found if the id is not in this space.

include_resolved.description: Default false. true also returns resolved threads.

page_id.description: The page id: the `id` field from publish_page or list_pages (also the last path segment of the page URL, …/docs/<page_id>). Only pages in the connected maker's space are visible.

name: list_comments
title: Read comments on a page
